question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Ratul’s capability of being __able to speak two languages__ is apt for this post.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bilingual"** refers to a person who is able to speak two languages fluently. (द्विभाषी)

 
 
• **Example: **She is bilingual in English and Spanish, making her a valuable asset to the team.
 
 
 
• In the given context, **"bilingual"** is the most appropriate term to describe Ratul's ability to speak two languages. (द्विभाषी)
 
 
• **Example: **Ratul’s bilingual skills are apt for this post.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **bilingual**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bicultural** (द्विसंस्कृति): Relating to or including two distinct cultures.

 
 
• **Example:** Living in a bicultural family has given her a unique perspective on life.
 
 
 
• **Bidialectical** (द्विवाचिक): Referring to the ability to speak two dialects of the same language.
 
 
• **Example: **Being bidialectical, he can easily switch between urban and rural speech forms.
 
 
 
• **Lingual** (भाषिक): Relating to the tongue or languages.
 
 
• **Example:** The lingual differences between the two regions are quite pronounced.
